name: Chisato Hasegawa
source:
Hasegawa is my grandmother’s sister — Once a renowned goddess of love. She watched over my [url=/c144568]mother[/url] and [url=/c144566]me[/url] for many years and noted how strongly I had inherited my grandmother’s traits. Relationships had never interested her, which made her astonishment all the greater when I awakened that feeling in her. At present her true form is sealed but the seal is unreliable.
